best_deployment_candidate.description: Full-coverage walk-forward ticker calibration. It keeps the event-gated selected-blend agent as the source model, but recalibrates the decision threshold separately for each ticker using only prior observations for that ticker.

best_diagnostic_candidate.description: Sharper selective consensus agent. It emits predictions only when the saved baseline LSTM, Sent-fallback event gate, selected-blend event gate, and clean regularized context specialist agree with at least 0.30 average confidence.

best_full_coverage_candidate.description: Full-coverage walk-forward ticker calibration. It keeps the event-gated selected-blend agent as the source model, but recalibrates the decision threshold separately for each ticker using only prior observations for that ticker.

best_safe_same_amount_candidate.description: Full-coverage walk-forward ticker calibration. It keeps the event-gated selected-blend agent as the source model, but recalibrates the decision threshold separately for each ticker using only prior observations for that ticker.

best_same_amount_candidate.description: Full-sample diagnostic ticker calibration. This shows the post-hoc same-amount ceiling when each ticker gets its own threshold chosen from the whole saved result set. It is not deployment-safe.

best_selective_candidate.description: Sharper selective consensus agent. It emits predictions only when the saved baseline LSTM, Sent-fallback event gate, selected-blend event gate, and clean regularized context specialist agree with at least 0.30 average confidence.

current_raw_lstm_metrics.note: Raw baseline_lstm and raw sentiment_lstm training metrics. The README headline Sent result uses the selected 25% baseline plus 75% sentiment probability blend saved separately.

current_selected_lstm_metrics.model_definition: Baseline is raw baseline_lstm. Sent is 25% baseline_lstm probability plus 75% sentiment_lstm probability.
